_about: Credits and licenses, shown from the menu and the page footers (author instruction, 29 October 2026). Each item names what it is used for, the notice its license asks to be kept, and the license. license_file is a path from the repository root; the build reads that file and shows its full text under the item. List only what a license or permission requires to be credited: work this project ships or copies (fonts, images, bundled libraries) and quoted wording. Something fetched at run time from its own host and not redistributed (Transformers.js and its model) is not listed (owner, 29 October 2026). Add an entry whenever something that needs one is added.
